svg.text: runs when the reply is NOT an error
String Subset ? offset is UNWIRED. An unwired numeric input is 0, so this takes the first 4 characters.
The refnum runs along the top of DUT_Query and the error cluster along the bottom. That pair is the ONLY thing
that orders your commands — LabVIEW has no top-to-bottom rule, only data dependency.
Build Array here has ONE input, so results is a 1-element array. Every test VI returns an array so the Sequencer
can concatenate them without caring how many rows each test produced.
legend: grey = TCP refnum, olive/thick = cluster (error, limits, Result, TestData), blue = enum + I32, orange = DBL, pink = string, green = boolean
refnum along the top ─────────── error along the bottom
